explanation: Merges the HypoMap atlas build (with main #99) into the study-card branch. From the base: changelogVisit.test.tsx pins the changelog closing when an explorer visit ends, and the report tests read the significance help beside the listing toggle. From this branch: the HypoMap fixture writes every study-card column (blank as an empty string, filled fixtureCard values by default); the atlas client tests cover named study fields, a partial card whose non-http link and non-numeric cell count read as null, a blank card and the Publication and Technology CSV columns; the preview tests read a checked dataset's linked publication and facts, and a blank card shows no details.
